integrity: All proofs and computations supplied as text and a standalone Python 3 checker; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts require a common strict item ranking, complete multipartite conflicts and agent count strictly above half the goods. The Gaussian limit is restricted to balanced bipartite conflicts. The derivation uses earlier SD-EF1/strong-colorability characterization and a classical hypergeometric CLT. Equivalent unindexed prior results remain possible.
title: Exact random-ranking SD-EF1 reliability with multipartite conflicts and a Gaussian transition
